title: experiment.evaluated (v1)
description: EvaluatorAgent has finished evaluating the RunRecord and frozen an EvaluationReport into the Research Store (see agents/evaluator_agent/data-contracts/evaluation_report.schema.yaml). Payload is intentionally minimal: the result is read from the Research Store by ref. EvaluatorAgent's EvaluatingExperiment mode is M12 -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

verdict.description: EvaluatorAgent's verdict on the evaluated run.

evaluation_report_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen EvaluationReport object.

run_record_digest.description: Canonical-content identity of the exact RunRecord evaluated. Optional only for backward compatibility with pre-binding events.
